Um plugin junta skills, agentes, comando: A plugin bundles skills, agents, commands and ready-made workflows for one kind of work. The format is the same as Claude Code plugins: you can install plugins made for it, and yours work there.

Plugins trazem instruções e às vezes scr: Plugins bring instructions and sometimes scripts for Claude. Only install from people you trust. Scripts still go through your permission rules (Clave asks before running commands).
Repositório público com um plugin ou um: Public repository with a plugin or a Claude Code marketplace
O Clave baixa o repositório, mostra o qu: Clave downloads the repository, shows what it includes and only installs after your OK. For a specific version, add #version (e.g. owner/repo#v1.2.0).
